The '''1937–38 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by three points over nearest rival [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]]. [[Dundee F.C.|Dundee]] and [[Greenock Morton F.C.|Morton]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1938–39 Scottish Division Two]].
